name: Khajuraho Group of Monuments
description: Rising from the plains of Madhya Pradesh in central India, Khajuraho is a cluster of Hindu and Jain temples built about a thousand years ago by the Chandela dynasty. Their soaring spires are covered in carved figures, from gods and dancers to a few famously sensual scenes. After centuries lost to jungle, about 25 of the original 85 temples survive, with Kandariya Mahadeva the grandest.
